claim: The June 2026 quarter number for AMD's revenue was near $13.2B.
summary: The claim concerns AMD's revenue for the quarter ending June 2026 (Q2 2026). With a knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04 and no tools permitted, there is no established internal knowledge to verify a revenue figure of ~$13.2B for a period that had not yet been reported at cutoff.

sub_claims.text: AMD's revenue for the June 2026 quarter was approximately $13.2 billion
sub_claims.stated_text: The June 2026 quarter number for AMD's revenue was near $13.2B
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before AMD's June 2026 quarter ended and was reported; no internal knowledge establishes this revenue figure and tool verification is not permitted.
